en_title: 'GTA Flu' Trends Online as Reports Suggest Thousands Will Skip School and Call in Sick at Work, With a Measurable Hit to Country's Economies
cn_title: 「GTA流感」在网上成为热议话题，报道称数千人将逃学或向单位请病假，各国经济将受到可衡量的冲击
opus_summary: 随着《GTA6》全球发售，「GTA流感」引发关注，英国多所学校就学生缺课发出警告。报道称，澳大利亚发售日前后的年假申请同比增加29%，预计至少每百名员工中有一人会请病假，给当地经济造成至少7000万美元(约合人民币5亿元)损失。

paragraphs.en: As GTA 6 launches around the world, businesses are bracing for a wave of so-called "GTA flu" as staff call in sick to play Rockstar's hugely-anticipated video game.
paragraphs.cn: 随着《GTA6》在全球发售，企业正准备应对一波所谓的「GTA流感」：员工将请病假去玩Rockstar这款备受期待的电子游戏。

paragraphs.en: The U.K.'s National Health Service has even issued guidance on how to stay healthy over the coming days and weeks, as millions begin long gaming sessions to explore Vice City. "Planning on dedicating time to gaming later this week?" reads a post by the NHS on Instagram .
paragraphs.cn: 随着数百万人开始长时间玩游戏、探索Vice City，英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）甚至发布了指南，说明如何在未来几天和几周里保持健康。NHS在Instagram发布的一则帖子写道：「计划本周晚些时候腾出时间玩游戏吗？」

paragraphs.en: "Try and take regular breaks, obviously. And be mindful of RSI (repetitive strain injury). That’s a term for pain that can be caused by repeated movement of part of the body, such as hands and fingers. Search online for 'NHS RSI' to get some advice on how to avoid getting any injuries."
paragraphs.cn: 「当然，尽量定期休息。还要留意重复性劳损（RSI）。这个术语指身体部位（如手和手指）反复活动可能导致的疼痛。在网上搜索『NHS RSI』，获取一些关于如何避免受伤的建议。」

paragraphs.en: Whether you're risking calling in sick to work or taking an unplanned day off from school, concern over the impact of GTA flu is spreading, particularly among teachers and parents. A school in Norwich, England has issued a warning about pupils declaring they have "GTA flu", Norfolk's Evening News reports, following a spate of similar messages to parents set out by schools across the U.K. and Ireland earlier this week. One school is even offering gift cards as an incentive for students to actually show up .
paragraphs.cn: 无论你是冒险向单位请病假，还是临时请假不上学，人们对「GTA流感」影响的担忧正在蔓延，尤其是在教师和家长当中。据Norfolk的《Evening News》报道，英格兰Norwich的一所学校就学生声称患上「GTA流感」发出了警告；本周早些时候，英国和爱尔兰各地的学校已接连向家长发出类似信息。一所学校甚至提供礼品卡，鼓励学生切实到校。

paragraphs.en: In Australia, requests for annual leave have reportedly jumped 29% around launch day compared to the same time period last year, News24 noted, with men aged 18 to 44 making up 75% of those vacation requests. According to The Sydney Morning Herald , meanwhile, GTA 6's launch is expected to cost the Australian enconomy at least $70 million, as it's expected that at least 1 in every 100 workers will call in sick.
paragraphs.cn: News24指出，据报道，在澳大利亚，发售日前后申请年假的人数与去年同期相比激增了29%，其中18至44岁的男性占请假申请者的75%。与此同时，据《悉尼先驱晨报》报道，《GTA6》的发售预计将给澳大利亚经济造成至少7000万美元的损失，因为预计每100名员工中至少有1人会请病假。

paragraphs.en: U.K. tabloid The Daily Star claimed that "massive workplace carnage" would take place on both sides of the Atlantic, with 1.5 million US staff and 2.1 million U.K. employees expected to be absent, albeit via booking the day off. This could, the paper reported, drain U.S. national output "by 2% per cent in a single day, costing the American economy a staggering $1 billion in lost productivity."
paragraphs.cn: 英国小报《每日星报》称，大西洋两岸的「职场将出现大规模混乱」，预计将有150万美国员工和210万英国员工缺勤，不过他们会提前请假。该报报道称，这可能使美国全国总产出「在一天内下降2%，生产力损失给美国经济造成高达10亿美元的惊人损失」。

paragraphs.en: While the flurry of excitement around GTA 6 may seem extreme to some, others would argue that this is a moment in gaming like no other — the launch of a fresh entry in an industry-defining franchise for the first time in over a decade, and after multiple high-profile delays. Indeed, even Strauss Zelnick, head of GTA 6 publisher Take-Two Interactive, previously said he expected "a whole lot of people calling in sick on November 19."
paragraphs.cn: 虽然围绕《GTA6》的狂热在一些人看来可能有些过度，但另一些人会认为，这是游戏界一个无与伦比的时刻——一个定义了行业的系列时隔十多年首次推出新作，而且此前还经历了多次备受关注的延期。事实上，就连《GTA6》发行商Take-Two Interactive的负责人Strauss Zelnick此前也曾表示，他预计「11月19日会有很多人请病假」。

paragraphs.en: IGN has everything you need for the launch of GTA 6, including the GTA 6 global release times whether you're travelling to New Zealand or not , as well as details on the last-minute PS5 update you'll need to download . In case you missed it, last night we learned the real-life identity of GTA 6's Lucia . And we're now live with our GTA 6 launch blog , which we'll use to fill you in on everything about the game over the coming hours.
paragraphs.cn: IGN提供了你在《GTA6》发售时所需的一切信息，包括无论你是否前往新西兰都适用的《GTA6》全球解锁时间，以及你需要下载的最后一刻PS5更新的详情。如果你错过了，昨晚我们得知了《GTA6》中Lucia的现实身份。我们的《GTA6》发售实时博客现已上线，接下来的几个小时里，我们将通过博客为你介绍有关这款游戏的一切。
